footer.tagline: FinTech insights and hands-on experience — through writing and consulting — for anyone building digital financial products or going deeper on market and regulatory context.
footer.interestBody: Share what you are building or exploring — consulting, architecture, or mentorship. I read every message.

home.closingLead: If something here resonated, tell me what you are building—I answer every serious note myself.

hero.title: FinTech and regulation, in clearer terms for product teams
hero.subtitle: I'm Mohammed Abdo—I consult, design systems, and write for teams building regulated FinTech across the Arab world.
hero.description: Part field notes, part front door: I share what I learn in public, and work hands-on when we are a good match—fewer guesses on product, compliance, and systems.

services.title: What you can hire me for
services.intro: Consulting and architecture for delivery; 1:1 mentorship when your people need to learn FinTech properly. Mix or choose one.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: I sit with you on requirements, stack choices, and risk: what to prove first, what to defer, and how to talk about it with compliance and partners.

architecture.title: FinTech system architecture
architecture.description: I help you shape flows, integrations, and boundaries so security and scale are part of the design—not a panic after launch.

mentorship.title: One-to-one FinTech mentorship
mentorship.description: For bank/FinTech staff and students: private sessions on product, compliance, or engineering judgment—built around your role and market (KSA, GCC, region). Managers: upskill without signing a giant training contract first.

roadmap.title: FinTech learner roadmap
roadmap.intro: Start from zero and build a practical picture of FinTech: product, regulation, rails, and privacy. The full path—with phases, expandable topics, and hand-picked references—is on the dedicated roadmap page.
roadmap.teaserNote: This is only a nudge to explore; the roadmap page holds the full detail—nothing is repeated here.

blogFeature.title: Writing to grow FinTech literacy in our region—in plain language
blogFeature.intro: Not a news ticker or ad copy. I publish long articles on FinTech, regulation, and product in wording newcomers and practitioners can both use—because my aim is clearer understanding across Saudi Arabia and the Arab world, without drowning readers in jargon.

regulatory.title: Rules & supervision
regulatory.description: What a regulatory change usually means for your plan and your controls—explained straight, to inform not overwhelm.

product.title: Product & go-to-market
product.description: How to think about launch when legal and risk sit at the table: what waits, what you prove first, and when “ready” is fair before you scale.

engineering.title: Systems & day-two ops
engineering.description: APIs, identity, payments, reliability—what runs behind the screen and matters to anyone who builds or depends on the product.

region.title: Saudi Arabia & the Arab world
region.description: Our local context—schemes, regulators, how people expect things to work—because literacy starts with “how it works here,” plus ideas that still travel.

roadmapPage.metaDescription: A full beginner-to-practice FinTech study path: phases, learning outcomes, topic explanations, and curated references—plus links to blog and contact for help.
roadmapPage.title: FinTech learner roadmap
roadmapPage.subtitle: A practical journey if you are starting from zero: what FinTech is, how money moves, how rules shape products, and what to study next—with readings and official references under each topic.
roadmapPage.journeyNote: Work through the phases in order once, then revisit the sections that match your role. Open the references, take notes, and connect ideas to one real product or regulator you follow.
roadmapPage.topicsSub: Each block explains the idea in plain language. Expand “References” for articles, regulators, and courses—verify anything critical before you rely on it in production.
roadmapPage.resourcesHint: External sites open in a new tab. Official sources (central banks, FATF, schemes) beat random blogs for compliance questions.
roadmapPage.disclaimer: This roadmap is a curated study guide—not a certificate, university course, or job guarantee. Laws and products change; always confirm with primary sources and your own counsel.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I'm Mohammed Abdo. I spend most of my time where regulated FinTech meets real engineering—helping teams make clearer product calls, tighter architecture, and calmer compliance conversations.
about.authorBio: I didn't start from slides—I started from delivery pressure, ambiguous requirements, and regulators who expect evidence, not vibes. Today I consult, architect, and write so founders and operators waste less time guessing. Maal Tech is my umbrella for that work: the blog is my public notebook; the rest is direct collaboration when we're a good fit.
